WITH t, avg(goals_in_match) AS average_goals_per_match, collect(scorers) AS scorer_lists
UNWIND scorer_lists AS scorer_list
UNWIND scorer_list AS scorer
WITH t, average_goals_per_match, count(DISTINCT scorer) AS total_players_with_goals
RETURN t.name, average_goals_per_match, total_players_with_goals
